summary: Senior Software Engineer and Chief Consulting Engineer with extensive expertise in full-stack development, Python, TypeScript, and AI-assisted software systems. Proven track record of designing scalable test automation frameworks, data visualization pipelines, and cloud-integrated solutions. Expert in leveraging generative AI tools and cloud platforms to build robust, production-ready applications.

experience.title: Chief Consulting Engineer
bullets: Architected and developed samkirk.com, a personal portfolio website with a Google Cloud backend (Vertex AI, Firestore, Cloud Storage) utilizing TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS.
Built Vertex AI-powered 'Hire Me' tools for hiring managers, including automated fit analysis, customized resume generation, and interactive Q&A chatbots.
Developed Photo Fun, an AI-powered photo transformation application utilizing Google Gemini, TypeScript, React, Vite, and Firebase, hosted on Vercel with Vertex AI production integration.
Utilized advanced genAI development workflows extensively with Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT, and Perplexity.ai for full-stack software development, testing, and documentation.
Engineered Tensor Logic, an interactive educational demo bridging neural and symbolic AI using a TypeScript/Frontend and Rust/Axum backend deployed on Shuttle.rs.

experience.title: Test Engineer III - Embedded Software
bullets: Conducted cellular radio modem testing and supported 3rd-party OTA testing using Rohde and Schwarz CMW290 instrumentation.
Created comprehensive documentation including a User Manual on Confluence and an API Reference doc using novel Sphinx extensions hosted on internal web sites.
Performed verification testing for instrument software, executing USB-based updates and manual regression tests.
Designed complete remote access environments for continuous integration and continuous real-target testing covering all system ports, buttons, and user screens.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
bullets: Developed a highly object-oriented test framework in Python 2.7 for automotive Over-the-Air (OTA) firmware update testing.
Implemented framework expansion and scalability featuring 3 levels of logging, stop-on-fail control, and dynamic loading of modular test procedures.
Created extensive YAML configuration files for test parameterization, utilizing Selenium, paramiko, subprocess, and JSON modules.
Conducted development in Ubuntu Linux environments utilizing GitLab for source control and Jira for issue tracking.

experience.title: Sr. Diagnostic Software Engineer
bullets: Developed hardware and software configurations for 3 standalone Production Test stations in the High-Speed Verification division running RHEL 6.3.

Co-designed and developed a test station cooling unit featuring a custom Device Interface Board and 5 BeagleBone Black microcomputers, writing all analog and digital software in Python 2.7 on Debian Linux.
Created telemetry event data log visualization using NumPy, Pandas, and Matplotlib for real-time analysis of streaming status data across multiple measurement dimensions.
Constructed SQL databases for parsed and cleaned data, synchronously correlating environmental data collection with system-level test logging.

experience.title: Sr. Software Engineer
bullets: Designed and implemented timing calibration features including Span Adjustment, Drive Alignment, and Compare Alignment for digital ATE instruments using C++ and Python.
Generated diverse XML timing patterns via custom Python scripts to support complex calibration workflows.
Co-designed four separate applications utilizing a generic parallel, binary search object.

education.details: Thesis: On-line diagnostic program for remote satellite telephone switches

additionalSections.title: Selected Professional Development
additionalSections.content: Completed a self-study, graduate-level course on generative AI applied to software development, emphasizing robust testing and developer-readable documentation.
